title: A delivery gone quiet
transcript:
Customer: My package is four days late and tracking has stopped.
Agent: I understand the delay is frustrating. Let me check the carrier record.
Customer: I need it for an event tomorrow.
Agent: I cannot guarantee tomorrow's delivery. I am escalating this to logistics for an update today.
Customer: Please email the update.

key_points: Logistics escalation promised; delivery and follow-up not confirmed.
expected.resolution_details: Logistics escalation promised; delivery and follow-up not confirmed.
action_items: Logistics to provide an update today by email.
